017package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.filter;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
020
021import java.net.*;
022import java.util.*;
023
024/**
025 * The {@code Host} values of a WebSocket handshake; over RFC 8441 with no {@code Host}, one value from the request
026 * URI's authority.
027 *
028 * <p>
029 * A handshake over HTTP/2 (RFC 8441 extended CONNECT) carries its authority as the {@code :authority} pseudo-header
030 * and no {@code Host} header, which a servlet container surfaces in the handshake's request URI.  A JSR 356
031 * {@code HandshakeRequest} exposes no protocol, so the HTTP/2 case is recognized by what an RFC 6455 handshake must
032 * carry and an RFC 8441 one does not: a {@code Sec-WebSocket-Key} or {@code Upgrade} header.  The container enforces
033 * that signal on Jetty and Tomcat (a key-less HTTP/1.1 upgrade is a 400 before any configurator runs).
034 *
035 * <p>
036 * Header names are matched ignoring case, because HTTP/2 field names arrive in lower case.
037 *
038 * @param values The {@code Host} values, in order.  Empty when there is no {@code Host} and no authority to stand in
039 *    for it.  Never <jk>null</jk>.
040 * @param synthesised <jk>true</jk> if {@code values} is the single value built from the request URI rather than a
041 *    real {@code Host} header.
042 * @since 10.0.0
043 */
044public record HandshakeHosts(List<String> values, boolean synthesised) {
045
046   /**
047    * Constructor.
048    *
049    * @param values The values.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
050    * @param synthesised Whether the value was built from the request URI.
051    */
052   public HandshakeHosts {
053      reqnn("values", values);
054      values = List.copyOf(values);
055   }
056
057   /**
058    * The {@code Host} values of a handshake.
059    *
060    * <ol>
061    *    <li>Every real {@code Host} value, across all spellings of the name, is returned as is.
062    *    <li>Otherwise, if the handshake has a {@code Sec-WebSocket-Key} or {@code Upgrade} header (any value, blank
063    *       included), it is an RFC 6455 handshake and the result is empty.
064    *    <li>Otherwise one value is built from the request URI: its host (IPv6 brackets kept) plus <c>":"</c> and its port
065    *       when one is given.  No port is invented, so the caller's scheme default applies.  Userinfo is never carried.
066    *       A <jk>null</jk> URI, or one with no host, gives the empty result.
067    * </ol>
068    *
069    * @param headers The handshake headers.  Can be <jk>null</jk>, which is empty.
070    * @param requestUri The handshake's request URI.  Can be <jk>null</jk>.
071    * @return The hosts.  Never <jk>null</jk>.
072    */
073   @SuppressWarnings({
074      "java:S3776" // Header-case, HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 authority branches read best as one sequence
075   })
076   public static HandshakeHosts of(Map<String,List<String>> headers, URI requestUri) {
077      var hosts = new ArrayList<String>();
078      var rfc6455 = false;
079      if (headers != null) {
080         for (var e : headers.entrySet()) {
081            var name = e.getKey();
082            if ("Host".equalsIgnoreCase(name)) {
083               if (e.getValue() != null)
084                  for (var v : e.getValue())
085                     if (v != null)
086                        hosts.add(v);
087            } else if ("Sec-WebSocket-Key".equalsIgnoreCase(name) || "Upgrade".equalsIgnoreCase(name)) {
088               rfc6455 = true;
089            }
090         }
091      }
092      if (! hosts.isEmpty())
093         return new HandshakeHosts(hosts, false);
094      if (rfc6455 || requestUri == null)
095         return new HandshakeHosts(List.of(), false);
096      // getHost(), never getAuthority(): the authority would carry userinfo into the host parser.
097      var host = requestUri.getHost();
098      if (host == null || host.isBlank())
099         return new HandshakeHosts(List.of(), false);
100      var port = requestUri.getPort();
101      return new HandshakeHosts(List.of(port > 0 ? host + ":" + port : host), true);
102   }
103}
